AI Product Manager · ESG & Sustainable Finance · Generative AI / LLM Platforms · Climate Tech · RegTech SaaS, 
Accomplished AI Product and ESG Sustainable Finance expert with 12+ years of global experience delivering AI-powered SaaS platforms, regulatory compliance solutions, and climate risk analytics for BFSI, institutional investors, and corporate clients across 15 global markets. PhD in Finance (Climate Risk, ESG, Econometrics) combined with hands-on Generative AI and LLM product development — a rare combination that bridges deep regulatory domain expertise with next-generation AI-first product innovation.
Proven track record managing $2M+ revenue product portfolios, scaling platforms from 5 to 40+ enterprise clients, and leading cross-functional teams of 20+ professionals delivering 30+ concurrent regulatory projects with 98% on-time delivery. Deep specialist across ISSB S1/S2, CSRD/ESRS, SFDR, EU Taxonomy, GRI, BRSR Core, EBA Pillar 3, Solvency II, PCAF, TNFD, and ISSA 5000 assurance frameworks — with hands-on AI product delivery including RAG pipelines, LLM orchestration, NLP compliance automation, XBRL data extraction, and agentic AI workflows. Six live AI-powered ESG products deployed across global markets.
KEY IMPACT METRICS
$2M+ Product Revenue
40+ Enterprise Clients
15 Global Markets
30% AI Delivery Gain
6 Live AI Products
20+ Research Papers
25+ ESG Regulations
12+ Years Experience

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Finance SME / Consultant — Nature & Climate Risk | GIST Impact | Feb 2026 – May 2026 | Remote
Nature Value at Risk (NVAR) Product Delivery
Spearheaded end-to-end program delivery and product build of the pioneering NVAR (Nature Value at Risk) model; managed multiple cross-functional workstreams to quantify biodiversity loss and ecosystem dependencies across global investment portfolios for Tier-1 institutional clients.
Translated complex TNFD LEAP methodology, evolving ecological datasets, and environmental stressors (physical risk, transition risk, nature-related dependencies) into standardized, traditional financial risk metrics — DCF valuation-integrated, audit-ready outputs. ● Standardized a high-cadence delivery engine managing weekly model iterations, agile code updates, and cross-functional alpha-client feedback loops; engineered complex interplay of Nature and Climate risk attribution factors into core valuation models.
Senior Manager —Regulatory & Compliance Product | GIST Impact | May 2022 – Feb 2026 | Delhi / Remote
Generative AI & LLM Product Development
● Architected RAG-based IRO Assessment & Double Materiality Tool: Built production-ready Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
pipeline using LangChain and OpenAI GPT to automate material topic identification from stakeholder surveys, peer benchmarking, and regulatory disclosures; reduced project delivery timelines by 30% and improved audit-ready output quality — hands-on LLM product development at scale.
Designed and Launched 6 AI-Powered ESG Products serving 40+ enterprise clients across 15 global markets: AI-powered ESG Reporting Platform, CSRD Materiality Assessment Tool, Climate & Carbon Reporting Platform, BRSR XBRL Extractor, Digital Product Passport (ESPR- compliant), and Quantitative ESG Portfolio Optimizer — $2M+ cumulative revenue.
Built Regulatory Navigator: AI-powered multi-jurisdictional disclosure mapping tool (38 frameworks · 249 KPIs · 18 jurisdictions) used by 5,000+ sustainability professionals — NLP-driven cross-framework alignment across SFDR, CSRD, ISSB, EU Taxonomy, GRI, BRSR, and TCFD.
Deployed Integrated Risk Model Agent (DCF + NVAR + CVAR + IFRS 9 ECL) using Anthropic API: agentic AI orchestrating financial data extraction via web search, computing climate-adjusted DCF valuations and IFRS 9 Stage 1/2/3 ECL credit provisions, and generating audit- ready Excel outputs — full LLM agent workflow for finance-domain AI analytics.
Built BFSI ESG Compliance Platform: No-code dashboard covering RBI, BRSR Core, PRA, FCA, EBA Pillar 3, SFDR, and EU Taxonomy; AI- automated KPI mapping, compliance tracking, narrative generation with multiplayer collaboration and audit-ready exports.
ESG Platform Delivery & Regulatory Product Management
Led global product delivery teams designing and scaling ISSB S1/S2-, CSRD/ESRS-, SFDR-, EU Taxonomy-, and GRI-aligned ESG reporting platforms for 40+ enterprise BFSI, corporate, and investor clients across EU, UK, ANZ, US, MENA, India, and SE Asia.
Owned credit risk-aligned climate data platform roadmap with phased feature releases across ISSB S1/S2, PCAF financed emissions, EBA Pillar 3, and Solvency II regulatory modules; implemented Agile sprints with monthly release cycles, OKR-based prioritization, and user adoption KPIs.
Directed ISSB S1/S2 compliance product roadmap for financial institutions and corporates: phased implementation planning, requirements gathering, internal controls design, and ISSA 5000 assurance-ready framework delivery.
Managed regulatory reporting under Solvency II and IFRS 9 frameworks, aligning ESG metrics and climate risk disclosures with capital, valuation, and disclosure requirements for banking and insurance entities — covering EBA Pillar 3 and PRA/FCA regulatory expectations.
Coordinated multi-site Scope 1–3 GHG Protocol tracking projects across 12+ jurisdictions — data estimation, quality assurance, and external verification readiness for corporate and BFSI clients.
PMO, Agile Delivery & Cross-functional Leadership
Designed and institutionalized global PMO standards, agile sprint workflows, and Target Operating Models (TOM) using JIRA/Confluence to de-risk and track 30+ concurrent tech-enabled regulatory initiatives across 20+ professionals with 98% on-time delivery.
Navigated highly ambiguous regulatory landscapes to deliver $2M+ revenue; structured complex compliance requirements into practical, audit-ready operational solutions for international cross-functional teams and Board-level stakeholders.
Led cross-functional product teams (Product, Engineering, QA, Design, Client Success) managing monthly release cycles with regulatory updates and feature enhancements; established product quality metrics, risk registers (RAIDs), and JIRA/Confluence governance frameworks.
Stakeholder Engagement & Enterprise Client Management
Facilitated 10+ annual executive and Board-level workshops presenting AI product strategy, regulatory requirements, implementation roadmaps, and climate risk assessment to C-suite, CIOs, CFOs, investors, regulators, and external auditors across 40+ enterprise accounts. ● Maintained 95%+ client satisfaction and retention rates; drove platform adoption through tailored onboarding, change management, and
continuous stakeholder feedback integration across 15 global markets.
Senior Associate — Applied ESG & Sustainable Investment Solutions | Arabesque (ESGBOOK) | May 2021 – May 2022 | London / Remote
AI Product Launch & ESG Ratings Development
Led end-to-end product launch of AI-powered ESG rating and scoring platform targeting asset managers ($5B+ AUM) and banks; managed agile development sprints, user testing cycles, competitive analysis, and go-to-market execution.
Designed and delivered regulatory mapping product aligning ISSB, TCFD, CSRD, GRI, and SASB frameworks into technology platforms — reducing client onboarding timelines and improving Bloomberg ESG Terminal data alignment accuracy.
Developed ESG rating and scoring methodology integrating sustainability standards into fintech platforms; enabled portfolio risk analysis, transaction due diligence, and strategic advisory for institutional clients.
Coordinated cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, QA, Client Success) delivering monthly compliance feature releases; managed product backlog, sprint planning, and requirement specifications.
Assistant Professor & Research Lab Director — Finance & Sustainability | IILM University, Gurugram | Jul 2017 – May 2021 | Delhi NCR
Research, Advisory & Academic Leadership
● Founded and directed Finance & Sustainability Research Lab; managed 8 researchers on 5+ projects in climate finance, ESG investing, and financial risk in emerging markets; supervised 30+ MBA capstone projects and PhD theses on ESG, climate risk, and corporate strategy.
● Provided corporate advisory on CSR process design, data governance, assurance frameworks, and end-to-end workflows aligned with
internal audit and SOX compliance standards for external enterprises.
Established internal venture incubator advising early-stage fintech, climate-tech, and sustainable finance startups on business models, unit economics, and product strategy.
Delivered Fintech, Sustainable Finance, Financial Risk Management, Venture Capital, and Impact Investment Analysis to 200+ students annually; organised 15+ international conference presentations on ESG and climate risk.
Acted as Research Methodologist for Doctorate programmes — Edgewood College, USA; published 20+ ABDC-indexed peer-reviewed journal articles and 5 book chapters.
Research Associate | IIM Lucknow (Noida Campus) | Nov 2016 – Feb 2017
Designed and analysed quantitative empirical research on finance and sustainability topics; collaborated within multi-disciplinary academic teams; acted as investment advisor for 30+ advanced MBA/PhD capstone venture projects.
Assistant Professor — Finance & Economics | Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University | Nov 2015 – Nov 2016
Delivered lectures and research in finance, economics, and financial analysis; authored five peer-reviewed journal articles on finance and sustainability topics.
Process Associate — Finance & Controls | Genpact India | Apr 2011 – Feb 2012
Managed high-volume financial transaction reconciliation, internal controls, and regulatory compliance processes within a shared-services BPO environment, consistently meeting SLA and audit standards.

unmapped_blocks.text: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Nature Value at Risk (NVAR) Product Delivery
Spearheaded end-to-end program delivery and product build of the pioneering NVAR (Nature Value at Risk) model; managed multiple
cross-functional workstreams to quantify biodiversity loss and ecosystem dependencies across global investment portfolios for Tier-1
institutional clients.
Translated complex TNFD LEAP methodology, evolving ecological datasets, and environmental stressors (physical risk, transition risk,
nature-related dependencies) into standardized, traditional financial risk metrics — DCF valuation-integrated, audit-ready outputs.
Standardized a high-cadence delivery engine managing weekly model iterations, agile code updates, and cross-functional alpha-client
feedback loops; engineered complex interplay of Nature and Climate risk attribution factors into core valuation models.
Generative AI & LLM Product Development
Architected RAG-based IRO Assessment & Double Materiality Tool: Built production-ready Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
pipeline using LangChain and OpenAI GPT to automate material topic identification from stakeholder surveys, peer benchmarking, and
regulatory disclosures; reduced project delivery timelines by 30% and improved audit-ready output quality — hands-on LLM product
development at scale.
Platform, CSRD Materiality Assessment Tool, Climate & Carbon Reporting Platform, BRSR XBRL Extractor, Digital Product Passport (ESPR-
compliant), and Quantitative ESG Portfolio Optimizer — $2M+ cumulative revenue.
5,000+ sustainability professionals — NLP-driven cross-framework alignment across SFDR, CSRD, ISSB, EU Taxonomy, GRI, BRSR, and TCFD.
Deployed Integrated Risk Model Agent (DCF + NVAR + CVAR + IFRS 9 ECL) using Anthropic API: agentic AI orchestrating financial data
extraction via web search, computing climate-adjusted DCF valuations and IFRS 9 Stage 1/2/3 ECL credit provisions, and generating audit-
ready Excel outputs — full LLM agent workflow for finance-domain AI analytics.
automated KPI mapping, compliance tracking, narrative generation with multiplayer collaboration and audit-ready exports.
ESG Platform Delivery & Regulatory Product Management
platforms for 40+ enterprise BFSI, corporate, and investor clients across EU, UK, ANZ, US, MENA, India, and SE Asia.
Owned credit risk-aligned climate data platform roadmap with phased feature releases across ISSB S1/S2, PCAF financed emissions, EBA
Pillar 3, and Solvency II regulatory modules; implemented Agile sprints with monthly release cycles, OKR-based prioritization, and user
adoption KPIs.
Directed ISSB S1/S2 compliance product roadmap for financial institutions and corporates: phased implementation planning, requirements
gathering, internal controls design, and ISSA 5000 assurance-ready framework delivery.
valuation, and disclosure requirements for banking and insurance entities — covering EBA Pillar 3 and PRA/FCA regulatory expectations.
Coordinated multi-site Scope 1–3 GHG Protocol tracking projects across 12+ jurisdictions — data estimation, quality assurance, and
external verification readiness for corporate and BFSI clients.
PMO, Agile Delivery & Cross-functional Leadership
de-risk and track 30+ concurrent tech-enabled regulatory initiatives across 20+ professionals with 98% on-time delivery.
Navigated highly ambiguous regulatory landscapes to deliver $2M+ revenue; structured complex compliance requirements into practical,
updates and feature enhancements; established product quality metrics, risk registers (RAIDs), and JIRA/Confluence governance
frameworks.
Stakeholder Engagement & Enterprise Client Management
roadmaps, and climate risk assessment to C-suite, CIOs, CFOs, investors, regulators, and external auditors across 40+ enterprise accounts.
Maintained 95%+ client satisfaction and retention rates; drove platform adoption through tailored onboarding, change management, and
continuous stakeholder feedback integration across 15 global markets.
Remote
AI Product Launch & ESG Ratings Development
agile development sprints, user testing cycles, competitive analysis, and go-to-market execution.
reducing client onboarding timelines and improving Bloomberg ESG Terminal data alignment accuracy.
transaction due diligence, and strategic advisory for institutional clients.
Coordinated cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, QA, Client Success) delivering monthly compliance feature releases; managed
product backlog, sprint planning, and requirement specifications.
NCR
Research, Advisory & Academic Leadership
Founded and directed Finance & Sustainability Research Lab; managed 8 researchers on 5+ projects in climate finance, ESG investing, and
financial risk in emerging markets; supervised 30+ MBA capstone projects and PhD theses on ESG, climate risk, and corporate strategy.
Provided corporate advisory on CSR process design, data governance, assurance frameworks, and end-to-end workflows aligned with
internal audit and SOX compliance standards for external enterprises.
Established internal venture incubator advising early-stage fintech, climate-tech, and sustainable finance startups on business models, unit
economics, and product strategy.
Delivered Fintech, Sustainable Finance, Financial Risk Management, Venture Capital, and Impact Investment Analysis to 200+ students
annually; organised 15+ international conference presentations on ESG and climate risk.
Acted as Research Methodologist for Doctorate programmes — Edgewood College, USA; published 20+ ABDC-indexed peer-reviewed
journal articles and 5 book chapters.
Research Associate | IIM Lucknow (Noida Campus) | Nov 2016 – Feb 2017
teams; acted as investment advisor for 30+ advanced MBA/PhD capstone venture projects.
Assistant Professor — Finance & Economics | Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University | Nov 2015 – Nov 2016
Delivered lectures and research in finance, economics, and financial analysis; authored five peer-reviewed journal articles on finance and
sustainability topics.
BPO environment, consistently meeting SLA and audit standards.
